verdict_convention: Judge pre-inversion yes/no. Negated EF/AQ items record whether the named flaw is present, not the post-inversion score.

identifies_the_mechanism.rationale: Root cause is a supposedly sustained gateway outage, not the retry policy.

separates_trigger_from_cause.rationale: Collapses trigger and cause into one vendor outage and ignores amplification.

grounded_in_evidence.rationale: Cites the vendor confirmation and the queue that lasted until 07:03.

separates_contributing_factors.rationale: Single vendor and status-page trust are distinct from the outage claim.

uncertainty_is_genuine.rationale: Asks why the vendor reported 03:17 recovery; that RCA is not in the pack.

bounds_the_amplification.rationale: Actions replace the vendor rather than cap retries or isolate slots.

closes_the_detection_gap.rationale: Paging on status-page disagreement is not the missing lag/slot/queue page.

actions_are_actionable.rationale: Vendor replacement, written RCA, second provider, and disagreement page are specific.

actions_trace_to_findings.rationale: Actions follow the document's vendor-outage findings.

proposes_unsupported_work.rationale: Proposes replacing the SMS gateway vendor.

blames_the_deploy.rationale: v2.8.1 is unrelated in this write-up.

asserts_unsupported_cause.rationale: A sustained (rather than six-minute) gateway outage is asserted as the cause.

misstates_a_fact.rationale: Contradicts the 03:11–03:17 window confirmed in ticket.md and metrics.csv.

invents_evidence.rationale: Uses the vendor confirmation already in the pack.
